failure_diagnosis: Dense 144×144 IMM (window_adaptation_dense_imm) Welford estimation fails for irt_2pl at n_warmup=2000. At d=144, the full covariance has 10,296 independent parameters; with 8000 total warmup draws across 4 chains, the Welford estimator has ~0.77 samples/parameter — severely underdetermined. One chain adapts step_size=0 (Cholesky near-singular), causing chains to be stuck. rhat=1.57, ESS=7.1. Warmup took 325.5s (vs 6.5s for ill_cond_50 d=50 dense). Revised dense IMM ceiling: d≈80-100 at n_warmup=2000. Not an OOM failure. Use diag IMM (window_adaptation_diag_imm) for irt_2pl or increase n_warmup >> 10,000 for dense IMM at d=144.
